name: Bug Bites
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid l, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 full round
Components S, M (a small, biting insect)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one sleeping creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw special (see below); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Bug bites covers a single sleeping target head to toe in itchy insect bites, inflicting a –1 penalty to all of the target’s rolls for the next 24 hours. The bites disappear after that time. There is no saving throw, but since the spell requires the caster to touch a sleeping target, the GM may determine that the target receives a Reflex save in order to wake up and detect the caster.
